# DiscreteGraphicalTimeline { #timetoalign.timelines.DiscreteGraphicalTimeline }

```python
timelines.DiscreteGraphicalTimeline(
    length=0,
    unit=None,
    number_type=None,
    id_prefix='tl',
    uid=None,
    name=None,
    locked=False,
    meta=None,
)
```

A graphical timeline with discrete (integer) coordinates.

Used for pixel-based visualization where positions are
quantized to screen coordinates.

Default unit: pixels.
Default number type: int.
Allowed units: pixels only.
